text.tspan: Share of people with an eating disorder, women vs. men 2023
Estimated share of women and men who have an eating disorder, whether or not they are diagnosed, based on
representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. This only includes anorexia nervosa and bulimia
nervosa. Prevalence is measured as the share experiencing an eating disorder at a given point in time. It does

tspan.tspan: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized.
